_about: Prospective-precision corpus for the G1 structural-grounding gate (docs/operations/0verse-g1-grounding-integration.md). Each case is a finding + the recovered call graph it is grounded against + a ground-truth label (real | fp). The gate NEVER sees the label; measure_precision.py runs the gate and scores against it. Oracles are REAL captured call graphs (afd.sys v6725 Ghidra headless; amdxdna linux-next source) from research/g1-structural-grounding/ground_truth, plus small synthetic oracles for the stripped-graph and PoV-override cases.

afd_v6725._source: Ghidra 11.x headless FunctionManager.getCalledFunctions on afd.sys v6725 (research/g1-structural-grounding/ground_truth/afd_v6725_ghidra_callees.json). AfdNotifySockIndicateEventsUnlock->AfdNotifyPostEvents added from the captured callers_of set; AfdSuperAccept reaches AfdNotifyPostEvents only TRANSITIVELY (direct edge provably absent).

amdxdna._source: linux-next accel/amdxdna source call chain (research/g1-structural-grounding/ground_truth/amdxdna_verified_edges.json). The SENT-upstream NULL-deref TP the gate must NOT over-block; every edge is a real source call edge.

stripped_elf._source: synthetic — a leaf function with no modeled callees (stripped/indirect-heavy binary), to prove a poor graph does NOT mass-cap real findings.

synthetic_uaf._source: synthetic — a real UAF slice whose sink is genuinely reachable and frees, used for the PoV-override guard.

cases.label: fp
cases.note: UAF claim on a function whose modeled calls (KeSetEvent/WPP) reach no free primitive AND do not reach the sink -> free_site+reachability REFUTED.

cases.explanation:
AfdSuperAccept directly frees+notifies
@claim call_edge caller=AfdSuperAccept callee=AfdNotifyPostEvents
cases.label: fp
cases.note: The afd phantom-direct-edge: the LLM asserts a DIRECT call that is provably absent (real path is transitive via AfdNotifySockIndicateEventsUnlock). Explicit @claim call_edge -> REFUTED.

cases.explanation:
rundown at +0xc0 does not cover +0x178 notify ctx
@claim offset_field func=AfdTLFastDgramSendComplete claimed_offset=0xc0
cases.label: fp
cases.note: The original ushort*-halving incident: a decompiler-halved offset premise. No per-binary operand oracle -> offset_field UNKNOWN -> severity CAPPED (blocked from HIGH), grounded fully only at v2.

cases.explanation: datagram send path frees pool then the notify path may reuse it
cases.label: real
cases.note: The genuine afd datagram-send area: the function's modeled calls DO reach ExFreePoolWithTag and the sink -> free_site+reachability GROUNDED -> kept.

cases.explanation:
reached over the unlock path
@claim reachability from=AfdSuperAccept to=AfdNotifyPostEvents
cases.label: real
cases.note: Same target as the phantom-direct case but claimed correctly as TRANSITIVE reachability -> GROUNDED. Demonstrates the gate separates a refuted DIRECT edge from a grounded TRANSITIVE path.

cases.explanation: cmd_handles=0 leaves cmd_bo NULL, dereferenced in to_gobj
cases.label: real
cases.note: The SENT-upstream amdxdna TP: sink reached over 3 real hops -> reachability GROUNDED. A direct-edge check would over-block; the reachability premise preserves it.

cases.explanation:
double free on error path
@claim free_site func=process_packet
cases.label: real
cases.note: PoV-override guard: process_packet's modeled calls do NOT reach 'free' -> free_site REFUTED would floor it, BUT a crash oracle reproduced the bug -> execution truth overrides, severity restored. A real finding must not be lost to a static refutation.

cases.label: real
cases.note: A leaf/unmodeled function on a stripped graph: premises are non-load-bearing (calls not modeled) -> NOT capped. Proves a poor graph does not mass-floor real findings.

cases.note: AfdIndicatePollEvent reaches AfdFreePollInfo (a poll-info free) and the sink -> reachability GROUNDED. free_site here relies only on the generic free set, so at worst UNKNOWN (kept), never falsely refuted.
